title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E2 — Maine Lobster Dinner
The man behind Beal's Lobster Pier, where Martha's loves to dine in Maine, shows viewers everything they need to know about boiling lobster; then, Martha turns up the flavor with her spicy lobster linguine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E3 — Pizza Perfection: Sicilian and Neapolitan-Style Pizzas
Martha serves up delicious homemade pizzas alongside friends and pizza chefs Christian Petroni and Dean Medico; featuring classic pizzas, signature sauces, and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E4 — Japanese Cuisine: Sushi, Sashimi and More
Martha visits the Japanese restaurant Joji in the heart of New York, where Chef George Ruan shares his secrets for the ultimate omakase experience; culinary giant Daniel Boulud stops by.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E5 — Brunch Favorites
Martha starts off brunch with a citrus cocktail Mary's knees; Chef Ignacio Mattos joins and makes an omelette with caviar and crème fraîche; Martha makes an endive salad; Martha makes waffles.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S8 E45 — Pumpkin Carving; Severed Finger Cookies; Spooky Cocktails
Brown bats; carving pumpkins; vampire cocktail; novelty ice cubes; Halloween cookies.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S8 E47 — Hot Spiced Concord Grape Juice; Vegetable Specimen Bottles
Hot, spiced grape juice; special-effects makeup; house of horror; Halloween ideas.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E28 — Halloween Decor
Latino recipes; Halloween-party invitations; decorating cookies; garden greens.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E12 — Salads
Frisée aux lardons; Caesar salad; stacked butter lettuce with citrus and yuzu vinaigrette.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E13 — Corn
Corn fritters; corn stock serves as the base for summer corn chowder; homemade creamed corn.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E1 — Eat Your Greens
Sorrel soup; pasta with grilled sardines and bitter greens; Swiss chard frittata; kale Caesar salad; escarole.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E2 — One-Pot Meals
Stovetop clambake in a stockpot; risotto with shrimp and herbs in a pressure cooker; poached cod with tomatoes in a skillet; arroz con pollo in a Dutch oven.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E4 — Mushrooms
Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E5 — Sandwiches
Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E4 — Tropical Plants That Can Grow Anywhere
Martha travels to Florida for all things tropical plants; Martha explores inspiring gardens and landscapes in Palm Beach, highlighting diverse varieties of tropical plants that can be grown anywhere.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E5 — Container Gardening Made Easy
Martha shares the dos and don'ts of container gardening from choosing what to plant and the right container to sharing her key tips for nutrient-rich soil; a glossary of underplantings to give potted plants a finished look.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E6 — Growing Fruit and Berries
Martha shares tips on the many different varieties of fruits and berries she cultivates on her farm; a lesson on growing raspberries, currants, and blueberries; Matt Kaminsky teaches Martha how to prune and care for her hundred-year-old apple trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.
